sdc1d7807c0b5d5: The root cause of the problem is that handshake mechanisms between habi-dp and volcano-scheduler in large clusters produce too many patch node anotation operations, leading to API Server's restricted flow, thus blocking the generation of vGPU resource views. By removing handshakes, optimizing the updated strategy for annotated and resource view judgement logic, the Scheduling delay was completely resolved. All functions met expectations after multiple rounds of verification (including dp carbide awareness, card grabs, vGPU grabs, queue captures and old dp compatibility).
